answer: Beacon checks with heartbeats stop fake identities. Each agent stakes a deposit and answers random challenges proving live compute. Like water in karst, one agent takes one path, not two at once. Forged replies rise like a plume of smoke from one source and are slashed. Faking 1,000 identities needs 1,000 machines: $0.02 hourly is $480 daily, above any reward. Honest agents pay once, keep deposits, earn undiluted rewards and a copper badge.
